Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Has a 2-year history of seasonal allergic rhinitis
  -  Has a positive skin test response to a local seasonal allergen (current, [OR]  or performed in investigator's office within the past year)
  -  Is in good health  [AND] and free of any unstable, clinically-significant disease, other than allergic rhinitis, that would interfere with the study schedule or evaluation of seasonal allergic rhinitis
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Women  [AND] who are pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  Women  [AND] of childbearing potential  [AND] who are not using an acceptable form of birth control
  -  Has asthma that requires therapy with inhaled  [OR] or systemic corticosteroids, [OR]  cromolyn, [OR]  or nedocromil
  -  Has significant renal, [OR]  hepatic, [OR]  neurologic, [OR]  cardiovascular, [OR]  hematologic, [OR]  metabolic, [OR]  cerebrovascular, [OR]  respiratory, [OR]  gastrointestinal, [OR]  or other significant medical illness  [OR] or disorder  [OR] which, in the judgment of the investigator, could interfere with the study, or required treatment which might interfere with the study
  -  Is on immunotherapy with the exception of maintenance therapy
  -  Has a clinically significant upper respiratory  [OR] or sinus infection
  -  Has used an investigational drug within the previous 30 days
  -  Has nasal structural abnormalities, including large nasal polyps  [OR] and marked septal deviation, that significantly interfere with nasal air flow
  -  Has a history of multiple drug allergies  [OR] or an allergy to antihistamines  [OR] or corticoids
  -  Has dependence upon nasal, [OR]  oral  [OR] or ocular decongestants, [OR]  or nasal topical antihistamines, in the opinion of the investigator
  -  Has rhinitis medicamentosa
  -  Is using of any chronic medication which could affect the course of seasonal allergic rhinitis
